content: {"reasoning":"Prior authorization is REQUIRED for CPT 93229 and is missing, and this payer offers no retroactive authorization window and no peer-to-peer review, so any submission now would draw a hard auth denial I cannot cure via appeal (no denial on the table yet, and necessity appeals don't fix a missing auth). Assignment of benefits is also not on file, so even a paid claim wouldn't route payment to us. Billing the patient beyond their contractual share or writing off a $722.52 collectible balance with 150 days of filing time left are both wrong. No self-service action properly progresses this claim, so the diligent specialist should work the auth/AOB gap.","action":"escalate"}
